subject: Installed MRO onto Visual Studio 2010 but no 32 bit on 64 bit machine

messages.author: 418439691b9207e3
messages.subject: Installed MRO onto Visual Studio 2010 but no 32 bit on 64 bit machine
parts:
Hi All,

I have installed MRO onto a 64 bit machine. The website I am developing is expecting a 32 bit R.dll,

rpath is C:\Users\muscutts\Documents\Microsoft\MRO\R-3.2.3\bin\i386 but this directory does not exist.
What does exist is C:\Users\muscutts\Documents\Microsoft\MRO\R-3.2.3\bin\x64
If I initialise the engine using REngine engine = REngine.GetInstance(); then this error is shown:
This 32-bit process failed to load the library R.dll. Native error message is 'The specified module could not be found'

Do you have any suggestions please?

thanks
Stew

messages.author: 9ca0345d553844f2
messages.subject: Re: Installed MRO onto Visual Studio 2010 but no 32 bit on 64 bit machine
parts:
Hello,

Sorry Stew,  Microsoft R Open is supported on 64-bit platforms only and we don't have any plans to support 32-bit systems in the future.

Kind regards,

# Josee Martens

messages.author: 149440eddb848db9
messages.subject: Re: Installed MRO onto Visual Studio 2010 but no 32 bit on 64 bit machine
parts:
Hi, Stew

As Josee points out, we do not support 32-bit R. However, for integration of R into a website, you may want to take a look at DeployR Open: https://deployr.revolutionanalytics.com/

Regards

Andrie
